title: NoéMI issue-coding-loop client registry
description: NOEMI_CLIENT_REGISTRY: client orgs entitled to the operator's pool tenant (Decision [2026-10-22-0005]). Injected from the vault at runtime; never committed. A client is entitled only when the conductor App is installed on the repo AND its account has an active row here.

account_id.description: GitHub account ID of the org or user the App is installed on. Stable across renames; the login is not used for matching.

login.description: Human label only. Not used for matching.

repos.description: Optional owner/name allowlist inside the installation. Missing or empty means every repo the installation covers.
